drivingQuestion: Are only the unwritten topics the essentials of Torah?

segments.he: הֵן הֵן גּוּפֵי תוֹרָה. הָנֵי — אִין, הָנָךְ לָא? אֶלָּא אֵימָא: הֵן וְהֵן גּוּפֵי תוֹרָה.
segments.en: § The mishna taught: «These [hen hen] are the essential parts of the Torah.» The Gemara asks: «These,» the topics mentioned in the mishna, which are not written explicitly but for which there is ample basis in the Torah, «yes,» they are the essential parts of Torah, whereas «those» other categories listed in the mishna that are written explicitly, «no,» they are not essential? «Rather,» one must «say» that both «these and those [hen vehen] are the essential parts of the Torah.» Every part of the Torah is essential, whether or not it is written explicitly.
